explore: If a place has decided it hates you, try apologizing out loud while you're still there. Places hold grudges. Places also forgive.
When a place loves you enough, ask it for a gift. Beloved places give the rarest things — if you remember to ask.
Secrets in Velmora aren't slash commands. You say them. Out loud. In the place's channel. Wrong guesses get silence.
Night changes everything. From 8pm to 6am (Velmora time), things that ignore you by day will suddenly answer.
The Garden's reflection pool wants a name before it'll talk. Call it something. Then ask it something.
There's a mushroom ring in the Garden. Step into it like you mean it. The hollow has opinions.
After dark, try singing to the moonblooms. They've been waiting for an audience that isn't a moth.
Under the owl oak at night — if you bow, something bows back. The school only lets that happen once.
Knock on the old gardener's shed. Politely. Or impolitely. The shed is not picky. The shed is listening.
By day, the broken sundial still has something to show you. Follow what it points at — crystal, then statue.
There's a door under the weeping willow by the stream. Not a metaphor. An actual door. If you can find it.
Someone left a map scrap in the Garden. If you've got it in your satchel, try using it while you're there.
There's a strange key floating around the grounds. It doesn't open anything in the Garden. That is the clue.
Whisper to the restricted section of the Library at night. Books that ignore you by day get chatty after dark.
In the Dungeons at night, listen at the drainage grate. Something on the other side has been waiting to be overheard.
When the Forbidden Woods howl, howl back. Matching energy. The Woods respect commitment.
At the Observatory after dark, name a constellation. Trace it. Claim it. For one night, it's yours.
Offerings change how a place feels about you. Bring the right gift. Sit with it. Don't expect a receipt.
The Dungeons and the Forbidden Woods are not safe. Explore or forage there and something with teeth may show up.
You can only explore and forage so many times a day. The Garden tracks you. The other places do too.
Stay in a place for a while after you explore — about an hour. Secrets and offerings only work while you're still 'there.'
Beasts that appear in the explore channels want exact things from your satchel. Read what they ask for. Then `/approach`.
Some beasts only come out at night. If you've never seen a Lanternback Stag or a Moonglass Owl, try after dark.
The stairs under the castle — the Descent — are not part of exploring. Different doorway. Different rules. Different regrets.
House-flavored secrets exist in every place. Thornmere schemes, Veyren bonds, Vashara promises, Caldrin inventions, Moonveil 'research.' Try asking like your house would.
Someone saw a golden frog in the Garden during an event. It trades. Three times. Then it's done with you.
If the trees glow, or a new path appears, or moths gather — that's not decoration. That's the Garden running an errand.
The Room of Requirement isn't found by exploring. You buy your way in at the Marketplace. The headmasters get pinged. Awkward.
A place that feels 'hostile' won't help you. Apologize. Come back. Bring an offering. Earn 'beloved.' Then ask for the gift.
Forage and explore pull from different pockets of the same place. If you've emptied one, try the other before you give up.
